The retained source response has evaluated parent-bulk and first-variation components, but its native independent-wall row needs a fermionic M5/M4 attachment. This continuation recovers the actual compatibility action and local handoffs, then proves precisely why their displayed equations do not determine that row.

The new exact result is a rank-zero fermionic constraint Jacobian for the v7.1 metric/scalar matchers and their v11.3 reciprocal successor. Their mixed wall/bulk derivative and same-photon derivative vanish identically at fixed owned bosonic inputs. This zero belongs only to those explicit known terms; the native AE4 c45 remains unevaluated. The intrinsic wall Euler action and same-dimensional sheet/reset glue do not supply the missing independent-H4 identification.

The report identifies the unresolved equation as `(g_plus,g_minus)=F_b(parent spinor data,L_L,e_R)`, or its equivalent owned joint allowed-variation/normal-output prescription. It retains the required mixed and source jets, including gradient/second-jet terms for a nonlinear identification. Unit normal overlap fixes the localized-mode restriction and cannot determine the complement map. The concrete recovered handoffs, exact action expressions, field types and SHA256 provenance are saved. The finding is scoped to those examined equations and handoffs, with no exhaustive absence claim.

The photon b_A remains the prescribed source; p=Xi_A phi remains an insertion image/diagnostic load that need not lie in Dom(D). No Theta_p, fitted coupling, boundary-family member, quotient theory or physical forcing is selected. Common-A, eta, LR mass block, domains and source continuation remain resolved at their established scopes.

Earlier actual node3 Green columns/time jets, Euler/load contractions, seven reference checks, the accepted72-coordinate parent solve, stationary return, two failed coupled charts and all frozen locals are preserved. No old point action, reference Gram or source contraction was recomputed or added to the native operator. No native wall update, shifted heat calculation or physical transfer direction was executed.

Validation: four new focused exact-algebra/evidence controls pass with repository-wide conftest excluded. The initial three-check run, an overly narrow first-jet wording corrected in run2, and a SymPy derivative-order comparison failure/repair are recorded. The old milestone checks and production calculations were not rerun.

Evidence: `theory/muon_fermion_seam_identification_20261005.md`, `scripts/replay_muon_fermion_seam_identification.py`, and `artifacts/muon_fermion_seam_identification_20261005/`. The earlier evaluated first-variation evidence remains in `theory/muon_joint_variational_attachment_20261005.md` and its artifact directory. These are operator/restriction results, not a physical a_mu/g_mu or native uncertainty estimate.


**2026-10-05: source-directed seam identifiability result**

The pre-mode seam arguments and intrinsic wall fields require an explicit action-owned identification on the parent complement. A symbolic bounded field-assignment witness now evaluates that complement on the twelve saved source columns, including the transported unit Higgs and geometric Dirac-bar reverse. Its frozen nodal coefficient is 0.0034617715565696057; it is nonzero on the coordinate-column space but nearly annihilates the selected original load. The volume reverse is a distributed bulk Euler action, not a conormal.

No coupling, boundary law, native operator, parent solution, or frozen local result is changed. The additional postulate is the off-mode joint field/allowed-variation identity and its same-photon derivatives; no numerical lambda choice is requested. Physical a_mu and g_mu remain unevaluated.

Validation: four new targeted checks pass; eight final artifacts match under duplicate materialization from one new calculation; all initial numerical arrays are unchanged. Fifteen input/source hashes, exact rational nodal contraction, equations, arrays and replay are saved in artifacts/muon_seam_offmode_identifiability_20261005 and theory/muon_seam_offmode_identifiability_20261005.md. Earlier production calculations and tests were not rerun.


**2026-10-05: cached propagated-field visibility**

Recovered the accepted source-centered node2 trace and reconstructed node3 with the saved tail recurrence and its same nonzero affine source. The existing witness is applied after K_L W=0, using only c3 in the identical saved W/p and source-column frame. Full left and unit-Higgs output norms are approximately3.50449121965181e-9 in the numerical-model convention; their arrays and geometric pairings are retained separately. The recurrence does not preserve the annihilated chiral subspace.

This is witness visibility on the accepted parent-model response, not a native coupling or Pauli sensitivity. Eta, source, parent operator, accepted solution, frozen locals and symbolic lambda/Y/H amplitudes are unchanged. Arithmetic/export/scalar and first cached pivot reconstruction errors are separated from unbounded full-tail/history/continuum errors. The distributed reverse remains a bulk Euler term.

Four new targeted checks pass; the corrected covariant form test was rechecked with three unchanged checks reused. Seven accepted artifacts match under duplicate materialization from one in-memory calculation. Twenty-one input/source hashes, coefficients, left/Higgs arrays, error balls, failed-save provenance, equations and replay are saved in artifacts/muon_propagated_seam_visibility_20261005 and theory/muon_propagated_seam_visibility_20261005.md. No earlier production or witness checks were rerun. The remaining target is the action-owned seam identification on the reached complement and its same-photon derivative.
